decision.label: CLEAN
decision.statement: No configured funding-linkage anomaly was observed with sufficient attribution coverage for this fixed scope. This is not a guarantee of legitimacy.

counterfactual.policy: Count shared unknown roots; show known infrastructure but exclude it from anomaly share.

attributionLedger.label: Shared unknown roots
attributionLedger.description: Counted in the anomaly share because the sampled traders converge on an unknown root.

attributionLedger.label: Known infrastructure
attributionLedger.description: Visible in the evidence, but excluded from the anomaly share by the sourced taxonomy.

attributionLedger.label: Attributed, not clustered
attributionLedger.description: Has an accepted funding path but does not meet the coordination threshold.

attributionLedger.label: Unattributed origins
attributionLedger.description: No accepted funding path was available in the sampled evidence.

limitations: Shared funding is evidence of a relationship, not proof of intent, ownership, coordination, or wrongdoing. This report is not proof of wash trading.
Funding attribution is bounded to two hops and a sampled subset of trading origins; unsampled or unattributed origins are excluded from the numerator.
Native-ETH funding coverage is best-effort and provider-limited; canonical ERC-20 transfers are the reliable funding layer for this scope.
Root classification uses a versioned, source-by-source taxonomy; addresses without sourced evidence remain unknown by default.
